# ThreadSanitizer suppressions for llcommon (the analysis workflow passes this file when it exists:
# .github/analysis/suppressions/<lib>-tsan.txt; see doc/clean/analysis.md). One reason per entry.
#
# Lock-order inversion between the locks of two LLSingleton subclasses (lockstatic.h): two singletons that build each
# other nest their locks A->B in one test and B->A in another. LLSingleton nests locks only on the main thread:
# another thread takes a singleton's lock briefly, releases it and hands the construction to the main thread
# (llsingleton.h, the wait loop of getInstance). A deadlock needs two threads taking the locks in opposite orders;
# only one thread ever nests them, so the inversion cannot deadlock.
deadlock:LLSingleton
